question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ALLEVIATE
solution:
The correct answer is: mitigate

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Alleviate means to make less hard to bear; lighten or relieve pain, suffering, etc.

 
 
• Example - *The doctor gave me an injection to **alleviate **the pain.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Mitigate means to make something less severe or less unpleasant.
 
 
• Example - *Getting a lot of sleep and drinking plenty of fluids can **mitigate **the effects of the flu.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Alleviate' and 'Mitigate' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Aggravate **means to make something worse or more serious.
 
• **Agitate **means to make someone become nervous because of worry or fear that is difficult to control.
 
• **Irritate **means to make somebody angry; to annoy.
